title: A Jablonski diagram
caption: Absorption lifts a molecule from S₀ to an excited singlet. It quickly relaxes to the lowest level of S₁ (vibrational relaxation and internal conversion), then either emits fluorescence (nanoseconds) or crosses to the triplet T₁, which emits phosphorescence much more slowly. Emitted light has lower energy than absorbed light.
alt: Energy levels S₀, S₁ and T₁ (T₁ below S₁): absorption up, wavy relaxation, fluorescence down from S₁, intersystem crossing to T₁, phosphorescence down from T₁.
description: Absorption: S₀ up to a high vibrational level of S₁.
Wavy arrow: relaxation to the bottom of S₁.
Phosphorescence: T₁ down to S₀, lowest energy.

claims.name: fluorescence emits less energy than was absorbed
phosphorescence is lower in energy than fluorescence
